# concurrency-audit allowlist — Pattern-A sites pending migration
# Format: <relative-path>:<line>:<StructName>
# See docs/development/concurrency-playbook.md for the migration plan.
# Generated by scripts/concurrency-audit.sh --update-allowlist
#
# Both entries below are flagged because the struct contains BOTH a
# sync.RWMutex (terminalErrMu, guarding the unrelated terminalErr field)
# AND a []string field (availableModels). The slice is set exactly once
# under sync.Once (modelsDiscoveryOnce.Do) and is read-only thereafter,
# so this is not a true Pattern-A concurrency hazard — the audit's
# heuristic conflates "any mutex + any map/slice in the same struct"
# with "mutex protects map/slice." Migration would not improve safety
# (the slice is already publication-safe via sync.Once's happens-before
# guarantee) and would add a per-read pointer indirection on the hot
# DiscoverModels() path. Re-evaluate if availableModels ever becomes
# mutable post-init.
internal/llm/providers/junie/junie_cli.go:30:JunieCLIProvider
